official_source.title: Rincian Biaya Transaksi di INDODAX
official_source.order_minimum_note: INDODAX Pro direct orders require at least Rp25,000.

public_api_comparison.selection_rule: Use the higher of the fee returned by the public API and the side-specific official all-in taker fee. The application uses 0.20555% on buys and 0.41555% on sells.

notes: The fee table screenshot embedded in the official article gives the IDR Pro rates shown above.
Rates are different for buys and sells; applying one 0.2% rate to both sides would understate sell costs.
This evidence records the public source checked on 2026-11-12. Recheck the fee table and /api/pairs at the beginning of any newly authorized test.
